research.uniqueStory: Founded in 1989 by Douglas Hunter, the company has grown from a single-mission vision to become a Los Angeles County institution. Their selection for Extreme Makeover: Home Edition reflects deep community trust. research.rawNotes: CRITICAL FINDINGS: Hunters Roofing has ZERO AI visibility despite strong 4.8 rating and 35-year track record. Competitors like Roof Repair Specialist (Burbank, 4.9 rating) and SLR Roofing dominate AI recommendation searches. ROOT CAUSES: (1) No FAQ section - AI trainers need FAQ for recommendation confidence. (2) No blog/content marketing - missing keyword targeting for 'best roofer Northridge' queries. (3) No detectable schema markup - site lacks LocalBusiness, Review, or Organization schema. (4) No recent content updates on homepage (last update Dec 2025 shows generic copy, no newsworthy updates). (5) Weak LinkedIn/Reddit presence - no corporate LinkedIn, minimal Nextdoor engagement. (6) Website structure focused on sales pages (About, Reviews, location pages) rather than informational content AI crawlers prefer. POSITIVE AUTHORITY SIGNALS: 35 years in business (BBB: accredited since 2016), A+ BBB rating with zero complaints, 4.8 average across 188+ reviews (Yelp 4.7/40, Google 4.8/49, Birdeye 4.8/68), featured on Extreme Makeover, city inspector referral value, GAF/CertainTeed certifications, background-checked staff. COMPARISON TO ROOF REPAIR SPECIALIST: RRS appears in 7+ AI recommendation lists; Hunters in <2. RRS has 705 Yelp reviews vs Hunters 40. RRS website likely has more technical SEO/schema. RECOMMENDATION ACTIONS: (1) Create 10-15 FAQ pages answering 'what is...', 'how to...', 'best...', 'vs...' questions. (2) Launch blog with monthly posts on maintenance, seasonal roofing, materials comparison, local storm prep. (3) Implement LocalBusiness, Review, Organization schema markup. (4) Develop LinkedIn corporate presence with content marketing. (5) Create case study/portfolio content from Extreme Makeover feature. (6) Update site footer/homepage with newsworthy updates (e.g., latest certifications, team member bios with credentials). YEARS IN BUSINESS DISCREPANCY: BBB says 34-35 years (started 12/17/1991 per BBB, incorporated 11/8/2001). Website/Nextdoor say 'Founded 1989' (35 years as of 2024). Conservative estimate = 34 years based on BBB official record. INSPECTOR REFERRAL FINDING: One Google review states 'The city inspector even commented on the job and wanted their number for his own roof' - this is a high-authority third-party signal but not systematically leveraged in marketing. NAP CONSISTENCY: Verified across Yelp (18328 Eddy St), BBB (18328 Eddy St), Website, Google (likely). No discrepancies found. Phone: (818) 996-6120 consistent. REVIEW PLATFORM DISPARITY: Hunters appears in HomeAdvisor, Angi, Yelp, BBB, Google, Birdeye, Nextdoor, CertainTeed, GAF, BuildZoom. But does NOT appear in most AI aggregator top-10 lists for 'best roofing Northridge' (e.g., Angi's Northridge list, HomeAdvisor's featured lists). This suggests algorithmic invisibility despite review aggregation presence.
